summary: IPERIONX Ltd filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a firm commitment public offering of American Depositary Shares (ADSs), each representing ten ordinary shares. The ADSs trade on Nasdaq under IPX. The offering size, price, and underwriting terms are left blank as the filing is preliminary. The registrant is the issuer conducting a primary equity offering under an existing shelf registration. No special-situation elements such as a takeover, restructuring, or divestiture are involved. Routine capital-raising through a follow-on offering does not meet the special-situation criteria.
